issues.problem: “streaming Taylor Swift’s concert on Disney+” was rendered as “在 Disney+ 上看 Taylor Swift 演唱会直播”. “直播” adds a live-broadcast meaning that is not in the source; this likely refers to streaming the concert film/show on Disney+.
issues.suggestion: Use “在 Disney+ 上看 Taylor Swift 演唱会” or “在 Disney+ 上串流看 Taylor Swift 演唱会”.

issues.problem: “an evening of scrolling” as “一个晚上不断滚动页面” is understandable but slightly mechanical in Chinese.
issues.suggestion: Consider “刷网页/翻资料” for a more natural Mandarin cadence.

reviews.notes: The translation reads as natural reader-facing Mandarin with Ernie’s casual, blunt, playful tone preserved, including intentional A.I. code-switching and technical terms. It is not a direct sentence-by-sentence calque; most clauses are adapted into idiomatic Chinese while preserving MDX, code, links, accessibility text, captions, and product names appropriately.

issues.problem: “顺得像抹了黄油一样” preserves the butter metaphor, but in Chinese it is a little more visually odd than idiomatic. This is polish-level only because the playful tone is intact.
issues.suggestion: 可考虑“顺滑得像黄油”或“顺得跟黄油一样”。
